title: Frequency card

techniques.name: Signal card

turn.label: Turn
turn.note: How far the loop is turned about its axis, added to the page’s own angle.

tilt.label: Tilt
tilt.note: How far the loop leans toward you, added to the page’s 0.85 rad.

tube.label: Tube
tube.note: Thickness of the ring’s tube, as a multiple of the page’s 0.32.

twist.label: Twist
twist.note: Height of the three-lobed twist along the ring, as a multiple of the page’s own.

density.label: Mark density
density.note: How many of the ring’s 13,500 sample points are kept as marks. 1 is the page’s own thinning.

coral.label: Coral share
coral.note: How much of the ring turns coral where it catches the light. 0 is all lime.

mark.label: Mark size
mark.note: Size of every dot and pixel mark the figure lays down (marks up to 6 px across).

techniques.implementation: A field of dots or lines is set behind one word and a small arrow; the field carries the meaning of the word. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
